summary: Completed comprehensive frontend testing of Ирис Design interior design studio landing page. All sections render correctly, interactive elements work properly, and responsive design functions well on both desktop and mobile viewports.

Hamburger menu opens/closes overlay with navigation links

About section with polaroid image and decorative squares
Services section with 3 cards (Дизайн-проект, Реализация, Авторский надзор) and CTA buttons
Philosophy section with 6 numbered advantages on green background
Portfolio section with parallax images and CTA buttons
Team section with photo and 'Присоединиться' button
Partnership section with project photos and 'Стать партнёром' button
FAQ accordion - clicking questions opens/closes answers with plus icon rotation
Footer with contacts (phone, email, address) and navigation links

All CTA buttons are clickable and functional
